label: GO step: rewarded a1 last trial, about to choose a1 again (win-stay on a1), early/mid episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1 or D2). It needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward==1; 0 activity after unrewarded trials) and the previous choice to have been a1 (or no previous trial in the window), and it nearly always accompanies an upcoming a1 choice (98% of mass; model_act==1 / choice logit > 8 do as well). So it is an a1 win-stay unit. The only FUTURE variable used is action at GO, which is the agent's own upcoming choice; swapping in model_act==1 gives the same F1 (0.787 dev). Activity falls steadily over the episode: rate is about 9% per step in trials 0-30, 2% in trials 70-79 and zero after trial 90. The ep_trial<70 cutoff accounts for most of the precision gain (0.50 -> 0.68), which suggests a slow drift in the hidden state across the episode rather than a task variable. The transition type (common/rare) of the previous trial, the hidden good state and the next trial's outcome add little. False positives are mostly matching GO steps where it stays silent, with no clear task correlate. Strongest activations are on a1 choices after rewarded a1 trials in the first half of an episode, often while S1 is the good state (good==1 carries 79% of mass).
